entities.summary: Kwanthai Sithmorseng is a professional boxer from Thailand. He fights in the strawweight division and is the former WBA Minimumweight World champion. He captured the title on November 5, 2010 by defeating fellow Thai Wicha Phulaikhao aka Pigmy Kokietgym and lost it on April 19, 2011 to Muhammad Rachman by KO. Kwanthai Sithmorseng was a athletes & competitors from Palian (b. 1982-08-18, Palian). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
